lanes.summary: The diff successfully implements PMAT-3629. It removes the `printf | grep -q` pipe from `scripts/fleet_utilization.sh`, replacing it with a here-string (`<<<`), and adds a deterministically padded test case (EPIPE control) to demonstrate that the here-string avoids the race condition. The `scripts/pipe_grep_q_baseline.txt` ratchet is correctly decremented by 1.

findings.claim: scripts/fleet_utilization.sh --selftest has no pipe into grep -q
a mutation that restores the pipe AND forces EPIPE ... turns the self-test RED deterministically
findings.command:
cat << 'EOF' > test.sh
#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
out=$(printf 'gx10\t2\t1\t1\t50%%\t80%%')
err=0
out="$out"$'\n'"$(head -c 200000 /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'x')"
chk() { 
  if printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qF "$2"; then 
    echo "ok    $1"
  else 
    echo "FAIL  $1: wanted [$2]"
    err=1
  fi
}
chk "gx10: 2 runners, 1 busy, 1 aprender = 50%" "$(printf 'gx10\t2\t1\t1\t50%%\t80%%')"
exit "$err"
EOF
bash test.sh
findings.output: FAIL  gx10: 2 runners, 1 busy, 1 aprender = 50%: wanted [gx10	2	1	1	50%	80%]

lanes.summary: The diff correctly removes the pipe into `grep -q` in `scripts/fleet_utilization.sh`, replacing it with a here-string. It also adds a positive control by padding the output string to >64 KiB, which correctly fails deterministically (SIGPIPE/EPIPE) when the pipe is restored under `set -o pipefail`. The `scripts/pipe_grep_q_baseline.txt` guard is also decremented by 1, fulfilling the ratchet baseline requirement. The other requirements (PR body claims, merge commit guard-tree) cannot be refuted by the diff alone. No contradictory assertions or weakening of gates were found. Verdict: PASS.
